hold_text: Tier-2 fix + repair mode for the mark-entry-unfilled DB writeback (no trader file); the manager merges, then the lane re-dispatches trade 8034 to restore its notes.
why: WHY: the 8034 writeback (issue #27646, run 44679734517) set exit_reason=entry_unfilled correctly but its notes became exactly {"_truncated": true}: the protected set (the reconciler's ~330-char closed_reason plus two ~64+ char prose keys this script protected) passed 500 chars and dump_capped fell to the bare envelope, dropping pnl_source='unmeasured' (INV-2 still flags) and pre_mark_exit_reason. The original notes are intact in the pre-write backup. WHAT: protect only short keys and let closed_reason trim; refuse any write whose notes would lose the marker or the reversal key; pinned on 8034's real notes shape. Adds --restore-notes-from <backup> (rows already entry_unfilled and missing the marker get notes rebuilt from a backup holding the same trade in its pre-write flat-detector state) and a wrapper repair pass that picks the newest backup passing a dry-run and fails loudly if all refuse. trader_import_closure: SKIP.
